title: VTC Events — Polls — Close — payload
description: A poll's creator or a runner of its calendar closes it, naming the time chosen and, optionally, making a draft event at that time. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

chosenSlotId.description: The time chosen. Absent: closed without a choice.

createEvent.description: Also make a draft event of the poll's kind, in its calendar, at the chosen time. Absent means false.

Response.title: VTC Events — Polls — Close — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/polls/close/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/polls/close/0.1#response.
